title: Note detail read failure or missing note remains a loading skeleton
reproduction: Open a note and make its detail SELECT return a persistent error or a successful zero-row result.
Wait for the detail query to settle.
expected: An error or missing note is stated visibly with Retry and Back. A background refresh error preserves an already open draft.

severity: S3: a note appears stuck and unavailable with no explanation
priority: P1: the user cannot recover from a failed detail load in the editor
